2609.25980.title: Interweaving Marginals into Multivariate Sample Paths: Training-Free Dependence Construction for Probabilistic Time Series Foundation Models
2609.25980.paper_summary: Probabilistic time series foundation models (TSFMs) provide coordinate-wise predictive distributions, but these marginals do not determine a joint distribution over multivariate future trajectories. We study training-free coupling of frozen TSFM marginals into multivariate forecast sample paths. Our primary evaluation fixes the empirical marginal sample multiset at every channel--horizon coordinate across methods, isolating the effect of coupling alone. Historical temporal and channel relations substantially improve their corresponding dependence diagnostics. The same pattern persists when the fixed-marginal constraint is removed and paths are sampled directly, and remains present under native multivariate backbone inference. These results support treating dependence reconstruction as a distinct post-processing problem for probabilistic TSFMs.
2609.25980.paper_summary_zh: 概率時間序列基礎模型（TSFMs）提供逐坐標的預測分佈，但這些邊際分佈並不能確定多變量未來軌跡的聯合分佈。<lb/>我們研究了將凍結的 TSFM 邊際無需訓練地耦合成多變量預測樣本路徑。<lb/>我們的主要評估在每個通道-時間範圍坐標上固定了經驗邊際樣本多重集，僅隔離耦合的效果。<lb/>歷史時間和通道關係顯著改善了其相應的依賴診斷。<lb/>當固定邊際約束被移除並且路徑直接取樣時，相同的模式仍然存在，並且在本地多變量主幹推斷下仍然保持存在。<lb/>這些結果支持將依賴重建視為概率 TSFMs 的一個獨特後處理問題。
